chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-01.proposition: Naturalists can construct a comparably explanatory worldview without adding God, regardless of the broad shape of causal reality.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently establishes Oppy's whole-worldview method and governing naturalistic thesis without requiring an earlier opposing move.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-03.proposition: Comparing explanatory coverage and theoretical simplicity requires judgment and can permit reasonable disagreement rather than yielding an algorithmically decisive result.

orphanFallback.rationale: Even without the moderator's earlier suggestion, the proposition independently specifies the epistemic standard for comparing complete worldviews.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-07.proposition: A necessary initial state together with necessary but indeterministic evolution can explain the occurrence of a contingent natural history without an additional non-natural ground.

orphanFallback.rationale: The described initial state and indeterministic evolution form a freestanding naturalistic model for explaining why a contingent history occurs.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-09.proposition: Postulating a necessary God does not remove explanatory bruteness unless divine necessity can be explained using resources unavailable to the naturalist.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently imposes symmetric explanatory scrutiny on divine and natural necessary stopping points.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-02.proposition: A naturalist can nominate the universe's initial state as an entity whose essence includes existence, so that explanatory structure does not uniquely favor theism.

orphanFallback.rationale: The initial state is presented as a freestanding naturalistic candidate for the essence-based role, independently establishing comparative symmetry.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-08.proposition: A broad category of religious experience is readily explained naturalistically, while a narrower evidentially stronger category raises doubts about how frequently such experiences occur.

orphanFallback.rationale: The contrast independently supplies a calibration test linking the breadth of the experiential category to its naturalistic explainability and frequency.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-01.proposition: Human faculties are not trusted without qualification; experience teaches the circumstances in which each faculty is unreliable.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently advances faculty-specific calibration as the appropriate general epistemic framework for assessing experiences.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-06.proposition: The disorder and ambiguity of religious experience fit nonintentional causes better than communication from an agent intending relationship with human beings.

orphanFallback.rationale: The contrast independently compares the expected clarity of intentional communication with the observed ambiguity of religious experience.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-08.proposition: The enduring diversity of radically different religious traditions resists a plausible single-religion account and is easier for naturalism to explain.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently treats persistent cross-tradition diversity as comparative evidence favoring nonintentional naturalistic explanation.
